case: ordinary custom-enum parameter inference under a same-named shadow search_path
contract: A target enum and a same-named shadow enum have different labels; the shadow leads transaction-local search_path while queries address the target table by schema.
COALESCE, NULLIF, GREATEST and LEAST each infer a text/NULL parameter in both argument positions; results and pg_typeof values are compared with explicit casts to the target enum.
Inputs include a regular label, the literal NULL label, the empty label and SQL NULL across rows containing those values and a NULL row.
A shadow-only label is rejected with SQLSTATE 22P02 for every expression position, and target rows retain their values and native enum type.
remaining: Other PostgreSQL enum contexts/configurations and the wider engine/type/consumer B3 matrix remain open; this case does not qualify 0.2.0.
